facts.fact: Jessica 深夜从 Tigglestide 狂欢烂醉归家：头发散乱、睫毛膏晕开、兔耳滑到额头，手里抓着半瓶来路不明的鹿血。
facts.anchor: She stumbled into the cold foyer, her hair wild, her mascara running, her bunny ears sliding down her forehead.

facts.fact: 面对 Sandy 问出的「是不是要离婚」，Jessica 毫无感情地确认离婚。
facts.anchor: “That’s right, sweetie,” said Jessica without emotion. “We sure are.”

facts.fact: Sandy 直接点名 Molly，Jessica 震惊孩子竟然知道这个名字。
Jessica 借酒嘲讽 Sandy 的魔法，还拿「Molly 的孩子多正常、我是哪里做错了」自伤。
facts.anchor: “Go ahead and cast a spell then. Hocus-pocus! Abracadabra!”

facts.fact: 决裂顶点：Sandy 高喊恨妈妈、跑出房间。
facts.anchor: “I hate you, Mom! I hate you!” cried Sandy and they ran from the room.

facts.fact: Greg 深夜未归，Jessica 明白局面已无可挽回。
facts.anchor: It was late and she still had not heard Greg return home.

facts.fact: Molly 深夜回到床边，说不能就这样丢下 Jessica 不管。
facts.anchor: “I had to, luv. I couldn’t leave you like this.”

facts.fact: Molly 正色宣讲：Hasenhurst 的一切美好都系于 Round Robin，想要她那样的生活就必须去见他。
facts.anchor: If you want what I have, you know what you must do: You must go to Round Robin.
